action.command:
cd /workspace && SUPER=$(grep '^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2)
echo "=== create teacher ==="
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/v1/teacher/create-one-teacher \
  -H "x-super-admin-api-key: $SUPER" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schoolSlug":"eckener-schule","emailAddress":"admin@schule.de","role":"admin","firstName":"Vorname","lastName":"Nachname"}' -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n"
echo "=== validate config via backend ==="
docker compose exec -T backend node -e "require('./workspaces/core-backend/dist/esm/constants/env.js'); console.log('env OK')" 2>&1 | tail -3
